browser_proof.scope: Root actually viewed all seven current Longhua captures separately. Near/oblique show physical tile eaves, galleries and openings; distant view shows complete small tower silhouette. Full detail returns after LOD/owner release and manifest reset. geometry_proof.scope: Actual exported Float32 part closure/normals/volume, exact decoded web oriented position/material triangle multiset and <=0.05deg normal rule; finite door/roof checks. Does not certify unseen interiors. All17983 previous v2 parts retain exact oriented POSITION/NORMAL and materials; only56 additional ridge-seat parts are present. This remains finite contact evidence, not whole-model collision freedom.

height_evidence.scope: 40.64m total/32.3m body follows the cited official nominal convention. No survey, common ground datum, measured storey height or verified photo metric claim.

roof.scope: Seven continuous curved eaves and distinct gallery brackets, tiles/rafters/finial; actual exported finite tile samples plus native visual review. Not whole-assembly intersection freedom or measured roof curvature. The 56 new solid grey ridge seats pass finite actual triangle contact checks against unchanged roof and ridges; decorative t>1 tips may cantilever.
